title: Thinking on Work after Covid-19
summary: Kahran and Divya think through the post-COVID distributed work landscape — whether it's ethical to allow work-from-home when some jobs can't be done that way, what kinds of work genuinely benefit from being in person (and which don't), and how their own collaboration across a 10-hour time difference actually gives them more overlapping productive hours than co-location would have.

intents.display: to think about whether remote work is fair when not everyone can do it
